'''East Quia''' is a sub-continent located in the southern hemisphere. It is bordered the [[South Quia]] to the south, [[North Quia]] to the west, the [[Northern Eanif Ocean]] to the north, and the [[Southern Eanif Ocean]] to the east. The continent covers around {{convert|8,401,652|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the 4th largest continent in the world, with a total of about 123,174,103 as of 1765, making it also the 18th largest continent by population.
